text:
Asha (ML): Quick intake — we have a new 13B open checkpoint to try q4_0 + int8 fallback. Need prioritization for bring-up. TL;DR: p99 < 250ms on 8k context, cost target: < 60% of current 13B fp16. Who owns the pipeline?
Diego (Infra): I can spin a dev pool (4xA10s). Please attach model path + convert script. Also need the perf harness link.
Nora (ML Eng): Adding eval buckets: summarization, instruction-following, code-completion, retrieval-RAG. Run prompt sets A/B/C (short/med/long). Need baseline numbers from current 13B fp16.
Sam (SRE): Put automatic fallback rule: if p95 > 350ms or error-rate spike > 0.5% then route to fp16 variant and page oncall.
Asha (ML): Draft checklist for bring-up (minimal):
  1) Artifact & provenance (checkpoint sha, tokenizer)
  2) Conversion script (hf->runtime) + quant config file
  3) Unit smoke: generate on 128/512/2048 tokens \u2014 measure mem & p50/p95
  4) Eval run: core prompts + structured-output tests
  5) Compare against baseline: embs L2, nll/perplexity on heldout, pass/fail rate on QA prompts
  6) Canary rollout (5% traffic) + rollback hooks
  7) Post-deploy: cost telemetry + quality monitors
Diego (Infra): Re: 2) share convert snippet here. We prefer a two-step: quantize -> optimize kernels. Example command we use: 
```
python tools/convert.py --model /mnt/models/13b.ckpt --out /tmp/13b-q4_0 --quant q4_0 --sample-len 512
```
Nora (ML Eng): Important: tool-calling + structured outputs often regress with quant. Add explicit tests. Example chat template for structured output we use in eval harness: 
```
SYSTEM: You are a JSON-output assistant. Always return valid JSON with the schema below.
USER: Extract entities and return as {"entities": [{"text":"","type":"","start":0,"end":0}], "confidence": 0.0}
```
Also add a JSON schema enforcement check after generation.
Asha (ML): And for API integration, here's an example Redwood chat call we want in integration tests: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \\
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
 -d '{
  "model":"13b-q4_0",
  "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: <document>"}],
  "response_format":{
    "type":"json_schema",
    "schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}}}
  }
}'
```
Nora (ML Eng): For prioritization: rank by customer impact + fragility + infra cost. My proposal:
  P0: RAG + instruction-following regressions on top-tier customers
  P1: general summarization & code completion
  P2: low-traffic internal tools.
Sam (SRE): Perf targets/bench plan: run lit-runner with these shapes: 256, 1024, 8192 tokens; measure p50/p95/p99, kv cache throughput, and memory. Baseline numbers (current fp16 13B): p95 @ 8192 = 310ms on 4xA10.
Asha (ML): Quality checks:
  - compare exact-match & f1 on QA set
  - hallucination rate on facts set (target < 2%)
  - structured-output schema pass rate > 98%
  - code exec pass rate (unit subset) not regress > 5% relative
ci-bot: smoke-run results: model=/tmp/13b-q4_0
  p50=120ms, p95=335ms, p99=520ms, mem=34GB, schema-pass=96%
ci-bot: verdict: p95 slightly over SLO -> fail canary gate.
Diego (Infra): Thanks @ci-bot. Plan: tweak batching knobs (max_batch_size, latency_target) and retry; also test int8 fallback path.
Nora (ML Eng): Note: schema-pass 96% likely due to trailing commas and missing quotes on some tool-call returns. We'll add a post-process validator and small prompt contract: explicit wrapper: 
```
SYSTEM: Respond only with a JSON object and nothing else. Wrap tool-call outputs in "tool_result": { ... }
```
Asha (ML): Action items:
  - Nora: run full eval A/B on trunk w/ baseline and upload report (owner: Nora, due EOD+2)
  - Diego: provision canary pool + add fallback routing (owner: Diego, due EOD+1)
  - Sam: add p95 alert + rollback policy to runbook (owner: Sam, due EOD+1)
  - ML: tweak quant config (calibration tables) and re-run (owner: Asha, due EOD+2)
Anyone object or add more tests? :eyes:
Diego (Infra): lgtm. I'll also add a perf tag in dashboard and enable token-level cost breakdown for the canary.
Nora (ML Eng): I'll include a small prompt-set specifically for function calling edge-cases (multipart JSON, arrays, nested objects).
Asha (ML): Great, thanks all. I'll create a short PR with the checklist and link the perf dashboard here once Diego has the pool.
ci-bot: created ticket INF-4932: "13B q4_0 bring-up: canary + eval" assigned to Asha, Nora, Diego
Sam (SRE): ping if canary still fails after tuning, we'll escalate to infra-sRE rota.
Asha (ML): Closing thread for now, will re-open with the upload link. :white_check_mark:
